block_name: Bill parser tool-use migration (sign + per-line + header reconciliation)

baseline_state.description: Pre-PR4 PROD state: persist.ts S135 Math.abs bandaid silently coerces negative writeoff/payment values; no admin observability of sign violations; per-line numeric fields routinely NULL on most PROD bills (frontend Path B helper pro-rates from header — citationSource='claim_header' is the common case); no header-reconciliation invariant (Jun 23 PROD claim 4d8c0cad has mutually incoherent header totals that go undetected).
baseline_state.prod_bills_with_per_line_breakdown_popul: low (S139 finding: per-line ins_paid/ins_adjusted NULL on Dec 12 PROD claim 3fa90e73; partial NULL on Jun 23 PROD claim 4d8c0cad)
prod_bills_with_sign_violation_known: f2c36497-525c-46df-9509-eabc5e94398d (Dec 12 2022 Swedish; pre-mig-132 had negatives; S135 mig 132 backfilled to abs)
prod_bills_with_header_reconciliation_an: 4d8c0cad-... (Jun 23 incoherent: total_insurance_adjusted == total_billed AND nonzero total_insurance_paid)

G2_a_sign_violation_rate.description: After PR4 PROD ship + 30d soak window, sign_violation verdict rate among bill_parser_decisions rows whose parser_path='tool_use' must be < 0.1% of bill uploads. Flag-OFF (raw_json) rows are not included in this metric (legacy path still has the Math.abs bandaid + new audit row).
G2_a_sign_violation_rate.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict='sign_violation' AND parser_path='tool_use') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parser_path='tool_use'), 0) AS sign_violation_pct FROM bill_parser_decisions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';
G2_a_sign_violation_rate.evaluation_starts_after: 30 days post-PROD flag flip to ON

G2_b_per_line_populated_rate.description: After PR4 PROD ship + flag flipped ON, per-line numeric fields populated (verdict NOT in per_line_sparse) on tool_use rows MUST be ≥ baseline_rate + delta. Today baseline rate is ~0% per S139 finding; PR4 target ≥30% populated by 30d post-flag-flip.
G2_b_per_line_populated_rate.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict NOT IN ('per_line_sparse', 'multi') AND parser_path='tool_use') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parser_path='tool_use'), 0) AS per_line_populated_pct FROM bill_parser_decisions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';
G2_b_per_line_populated_rate.evaluation_starts_after: 30 days post-PROD flag flip to ON

G2_c_header_reconciliation_failure_rate.description: After PR4 PROD ship, header_reconciliation_failed verdict rate must stay < 5% (residual noise from legitimately-incomplete header data; today Jun 23 PROD claim is the only known case).
G2_c_header_reconciliation_failure_rate.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict='header_reconciliation_failed' OR (verdict='multi' AND header_reconciliation_delta IS NOT NULL)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS header_failure_pct FROM bill_parser_decisions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';
G2_c_header_reconciliation_failure_rate.evaluation_starts_after: 30 days post-PROD ship (flag OFF or ON; B-2 fires regardless of parser path)

G2_d_b_4_telemetry_signal_trigger.description: B-4 trigger query for frontend Path B helper + persist.ts Math.abs guard removal (Pattern D sunset). After PR4 PROD ship: dispute_outcomes.metadata.citation_source rate of 'claim_header' must drop to < 1% sustained 14 days. Until then, frontend Math.abs guard stays.
G2_d_b_4_telemetry_signal_trigger.query: SELECT metadata->>'citation_source' AS source, COUNT(*) FROM dispute_outcomes WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY 1;
G2_d_b_4_telemetry_signal_trigger.evaluation_starts_after: 30 days post-PR4 PROD ship (frontend bandaid stays for 30d soak; then B-4 trigger query runs weekly)

rollout_plan.ship: PR4 merged to main + bundled PROD push promotes mig 133 (flag default OFF). Code lives in PROD under flag-off semantics (legacy raw_json code path active; new audit infra fires on every persist).

smoke_pre_pr.description: Re-process all 14 PROD bills on local dev server with flag OFF + flag ON; record bill_parser_decisions verdicts in both modes. Goal: parity on raw_json path + new per-line breakdown on tool_use path on bills where the source PDF actually shows the column.
smoke_pre_pr.corpus_source: all bill-type documents in PROD as of S140 close
evaluation_criteria: raw_json path produces same persisted claim totals as today (regression test)
tool_use path produces additional per-line numeric populated rows on bills with breakdown column
zero sign_violation verdicts on the 14-bill corpus (mig 132 already cleaned existing negatives; new parses shouldn't regress)

smoke_post_alpha.description: Alpha+30d trigger: re-run smoke at ≥100-bill corpus per Ship Gate G3 rare-event scale (S136 reframe). Until alpha launches, the 14-bill corpus is the strongest pre-PR signal we have.
smoke_post_alpha.trigger: B10 alpha launch + 30 days OR ≥100 bill uploads accumulated post-launch

flag_flip_to_on.description: Soak window AFTER PR4 PROD ship before flipping bill_parser_tool_use_v1 to ON globally. Allows the audit infra (raw_json path) to surface verdict-rate baseline first.
flag_flip_to_on.evaluation_query: SELECT verdict, parser_path, COUNT(*) FROM bill_parser_decisions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2;
flag_flip_to_on.pass_criteria: raw_json baseline verdict distribution matches expected (clean dominant; sign_violation 0%; per_line_sparse high — matches today's PROD reality)
